findings.title: Connect the saved timeout to the shutdown drain
findings.body: Submitting shutdown_drain_timeout=120.5 now succeeds and persists that value, but scheduler.py:70–81 still computes the timeout solely from the environment at import time, and line 634 uses that constant. With no environment override, shutdown still stops waiting after 60 seconds, ignoring the newly accepted setting even after restart.
findings.recommendation: Resolve the drain timeout from the current application settings at shutdown, with the intended environment override precedence, and verify that a saved nondefault value changes the actual drain deadline.

findings.recommendation: Add a numeric input associated with settings-form, populated from shutdown_drain_timeout and supporting fractional values. Verify that a nondefault value survives a browser-form save.
